parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the E-HPC cluster.

parameters.name: Duration
parameters.description:
The duration of the profiling process. Unit: seconds.

Value values: 10 to 300.

Default value: 30.

parameters.name: Freq
parameters.description:
The sampling frequency. Unit: Hz. Valid values: 1 to 2000.

Default value: 2000.

parameters.name: ProcessId
parameters.description: The ID of the profiling process.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpc run-cloud-metric-profiling --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id ehpc-hz-jeJki60000 --host-name compute0 --process-id 29075 --duration 300 --freq 2000 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
